description: This Java test source file, MappingStrategiesBuilderTest.java, contains unit tests for the MappingStrategiesBuilder class related to building mapping strategies for JSON parsing and registration within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.cluster' package.

classes.name: MappingStrategiesBuilderTest
